reason: Adversarial review (wf_69b5938a-634-6) checked the stacking/non-stacking split against the pinned oracle (cr_classes.lst, PCGEN_ORACLE_SHA 7f818006e371188e5717fd18d74d18a420747fc6) and found the original event's 'scope' and the in-code note's CONCLUSION had it backwards for 2 of 10: Arcane Archer was filed as non-stacking (it carries ADD:SPELLCASTER|Arcane at 7 of its 10 levels, cr_classes.lst:334-340) and Pathfinder Chronicler was filed as needing the stacking mechanism (it has zero spellcasting of any kind, cr_classes.lst:467-485). Root cause: the original probe scanned data/corpus/core_rulebook/class_feature/<class>/ for a spell-shaped record, which is blind to advancement encoded directly on the CLASS: line via ADD:SPELLCASTER rather than as a separate feature record.
resolution: Corrected the in-code comment at src/rules_core/pilot_compute/mod.rs (after table_class_id) during the wave-27 integration cycle. Corrected split: STACKING = Arcane Archer, Arcane Trickster, Dragon Disciple, Eldritch Knight, Loremaster, Mystic Theurge (6). NON-STACKING = Assassin, Duelist, Pathfinder Chronicler, Shadowdancer (4).
summary: Correction: prestige-class stacking/non-stacking split had Arcane Archer and Pathfinder Chronicler backwards; fixed in both the in-code note and this event log.
